reviews.title: Defective product received/ No replacement policy
reviews.body: Product didnot work during Installation on 16th October. When requested Amazon, it diverted the call to Kent to get the product serviced instead of replacement. Kent local dealer visited multiple times , but unable to fix the problem. Finally they have take the product to the service center after 10 days of delivery. The area sales manager dont pickup my calls. Worst product and replacement policy. I am very much disappointed.
